title: Group OSCORE: epoch/key manager module
description: Child of 9mkj epic. New module in python/src/lichen: group key state = group_id, key_epoch u32 monotonic wrapping at 4294967295, current master_secret, previous epoch+key with rekey timestamp. Validation: message epoch < current -> rollback reject; epoch > current+1 unknown-future reject. Drives vectors key_epoch_increment, epoch_rollback_reject, epoch_future_reject.
close_reason: Duplicate of 9mkj.1 (same epoch/key manager scope), created by a retry after a dep-conflict error.
